title: Academic Calendar 2026-27 - Odd Semester - Except First Year
text:
Academic Calendar: Odd Semester 2026-27.
Applicable to: B.Tech, M.Tech and MCA, except first-year students.
This calendar is different from the first-year academic calendar.
Student Registration: 20 July 2026.
Commencement of Classes: 21 July 2026.
Sessional Test 1 (ST1): 17-22 August 2026.
Distribution of Corrected ST1 Answer Scripts: 27 August 2026.
Mid Term Lab Assessment: 7-11 September 2026.
Sessional Test 2 (ST2): 21-26 September 2026.
Distribution of Corrected ST2 Answer Scripts: 1 October 2026.
End Term Lab Assessment: 26-30 October 2026.
Last Teaching Day - B.Tech 3rd Year: 30 October 2026.
Last Teaching Day - Other Students: 5 November 2026.
Pre-University Test - B.Tech 3rd Year: 2-20 November 2026.
Pre-University Test - Other Students: 13-27 November 2026.
PUT Marks Submission - B.Tech 3rd Year: 26 November 2026.
PUT Marks Submission - Other Students: 3 December 2026.
External End Semester Examination Date Range: 24 November-27 December 2026.
